value.rationale: The union of two complete Hamming layers with controlled masses is the minimal natural stratified sampling support that reduces the quadratic Walsh blind space from n+1 dimensions on one layer to a single radial ambiguity. The all-dimension exact rank, roots, multiplicities and sharp least/greatest nonzero sampling singular values give an independently interpretable stability classification for every interior pair and positive mass, not an isolated tiny numeric computation. The new mathematical content is modest because known permutation-symmetry blocks and elementary 2x2 algebra make the classification directly derivable; no optimization over layer designs, higher-degree theorem or practical robustness beyond the exact quotient norm is asserted. Within the agreed natural exact invariant/classification bar, the complete two-layer spectral law remains worth recording, conditional on the originality risk above.

final_claim: For every integer n>=5, all integers 2<=k<ell<=n-2, and every real 0<theta<1, degree-at-most-two Walsh polynomials restricted to the convex probability mixture of the complete Hamming-k and Hamming-ell shells have Gram rank n+binom(n,2) and unique kernel span{(L-(n-2k))(L-(n-2ell))}. Their nonzero coefficient-Gram eigenvalues are the two positive roots of z^2-T0*z+D0 (multiplicity 1), the two positive roots of z^2-T1*z+D1 (multiplicity n-1), and H2>0 (multiplicity n(n-3)/2), for the five exact scalars defined in frozen RESULT.md. Coincident levels combine; sharp quotient squared singular-value endpoints are their minimum and maximum.
limitations: The fully general theorem rests on the source proof, not five finite exact checks; strict theta>0 and <1 and k,l strictly interior are essential.
No formal Lean or expert attestation was produced; previously existing verification channels are preserved.
